text:
maya: Quick async — optkit delivery status check. Ownership + deps. TL;DR: quant recs for bert-xx landed in main (PR #4621), batching shim PR needs CR, cache infra (eng-infra) to confirm KV retention config. @arjun @zara can you ack and give ETA?

arjun: Ack. I'll CR the batching shim today. ETA for PR fix + CI green by EOD. Need @kira to approve perf tests.

zara: Noted. Eng-infra owes KV retention update (issue #118). I've pinged them. Also FYI regression-alert flagged a small LM perplexity bump on eval-suite-7.

regression-bot: regression-alert: eval-suite-7: bert-xx quantize-16 -> +1.8% perplexity at seq=512. Linked artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/2026/04/12/bert-xx/quant16/logs.tar.gz

sam: Can we get an owner for canary rollout? If perf looks okay we want to roll to dedicated pool next week.

leo: Heads-up — perf CI had 3 runs failing on batching shim with OOM at step 120. Snip from logs:
```
E tensorflow: GPU OOM at alloc 2.1GB
stack: serving/runtime/batch_queue.cc:87
```
I think it's a batch size boundary for seq>256.

kira: I'll take the CR for batching shim this afternoon. Also will run targeted perf with seq=512 and KV cache enabled.

arjun: thx @kira. If you confirm no regression we can canary. If not, we rollback quant profile for bert-xx to q8 until fix.

zara: Eng-infra responded — KV retention config default remains 30m for now, they can extend to 2h if we request. Are 2h retention + caching safe for memory? @leo

leo: 2h retention increases memory pressure but should be fine on dedicated nodes with 64GB. For hosted we should be conservative. Need to add memory guardrails in runtime (low priority flag).

sam: Action items: 1) @kira CR + perf runs (EOD) 2) @arjun apply small guardrail patch if perf flaky 3) @zara confirm KV retention req to infra 4) @maya coordinate canary schedule. I'll open a short checklist doc. :memo:

maya: Thanks. I'll schedule a 30m shiproom tomorrow and add these items to the optkit delivery board. Leaving this thread open for async updates — drop short pings here (no long threads). :thumbsup:
